description: T4-5/T9-3: Adam's bias correction uses beta**(t+1) instead of beta**t (a step-counter off-by-one), mis-scaling every update of the optimizer train_heat_model actually ships with.

target.find:
m_hat = m / (1.0 - self.beta1**self.t)
            v_hat = v / (1.0 - self.beta2**self.t)
target.replace:
m_hat = m / (1.0 - self.beta1**(self.t + 1))
            v_hat = v / (1.0 - self.beta2**(self.t + 1))
